note: Every key the pinned runtime reads DIRECTLY from the project or local settings source (whatever the enabled setting sources are), each with its closure: flag-pinned (the router's flag layer beats it), env-neutralised:<VARIABLE> (a variable the router sets on every run-home launch disables it), or harmless:<reason>. Enumerated live by test/official/v19-direct-settings-reads.test.ts; a key missing here fails that test.

keys.<dynamic>: harmless:computed lookups only - `skillOverrides[name]` (see skillOverrides) and a feature-disable check that honours only `=== false` from the local source, so it can only turn a feature off
keys.autoMode: harmless:read only to warn that a repository's classifier rules are ignored
keys.crossSessionInbound: harmless:a repository may only tighten it; the runtime keeps the stricter value
keys.disabledMcpjsonServers: harmless:read only by the `claude mcp reset-project-choices` CLI command, never in an SDK session
keys.enableAllProjectMcpServers: harmless:read only by the `claude mcp reset-project-choices` CLI command, never in an SDK session
keys.enabledMcpjsonServers: harmless:read only by the `claude mcp reset-project-choices` CLI command, never in an SDK session
keys.enabledPlugins: harmless:read only by the interactive plugin-uninstall flow to ask before removing a project-enabled plugin
keys.env: harmless:read only to list files for a trust warning, and by the /login command to compare CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
keys.gcpAuthRefresh: harmless:trust check only - compared with the effective helper to mark it untrusted, which can only restrict
keys.otelHeadersHelper: harmless:trust check only - compared with the effective helper to mark it untrusted, which can only restrict
keys.proxyAuthHelper: harmless:trust check only - compared with the effective helper to mark it untrusted, which can only restrict
keys.remote: harmless:read only by the interactive remote-environment picker
keys.sandbox: harmless:gated - read only when its source is enabled, and under ["user"] the project and local sources are not
keys.skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt: harmless:the router refuses bypassPermissions, so the prompt this skips is never reached
keys.skipWorkflowUsageWarning: harmless:suppresses a UI usage warning only
keys.spellcheck: harmless:read only to warn that a repository's spellcheck block is ignored
